purpose: Freeze one common Sentinel-1 change-feature definition before Cashahuacra R3 support is known and before any SAR pre/post change value is inspected, so later parallel windows use exactly the same feature code and metrics.

execution_prerequisites.r2: exact same frozen processing graph applied independently to pre and post with compatible acquisition pair and verified precise-orbit consumption
execution_prerequisites.input_crops: lossless identical-grid basin-window crops frozen by SHA-256
execution_prerequisites.support_mask: binary R3 common-support mask frozen by SHA-256

radiometric_domain.validity: strictly positive finite values only and R3 common-support mask=1
radiometric_domain.sign_assumption: NONE; positive and negative changes are reported separately and no direction is assumed to imply activation

fixed_change_threshold_db.physical_reason: A 3 dB absolute change corresponds approximately to a factor-of-two change in radar power and is fixed for interpretability, not estimated from Cashahuacra or outcomes.

primary_features.definition: median(post_dB - pre_dB) over R3 common support
median(abs(post_dB - pre_dB)) over R3 common support
fraction of R3 common-support pixels with abs(delta_dB) >= 3.0
fraction of R3 common-support pixels with delta_dB <= -3.0
fraction of R3 common-support pixels with delta_dB >= +3.0
size of largest 8-connected component satisfying abs(delta_dB) >= 3.0 divided by common-support pixel count

fixed_diagnostic_quantiles.semantics: diagnostic distribution descriptors retained for all windows; not an activation classification

forbidden_actions: choose only positive or only negative change after inspecting Cashahuacra
change 3 dB threshold after inspecting Cashahuacra or controls
apply post-hoc spatial smoothing to improve coherence
discard selected blind windows because SAR change is weak or inconvenient
interpret any R4 metric as activation before independent territorial unblind
assign case/control role from SAR magnitude
